program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if (grid[r][c] == 2 and grid[r][c + 1] == 2 and
                grid[r + 1][c] == 2 and grid[r + 1][c + 1] == 2):
                blocks.append((r, c))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda p: p[1])
    n = len(blocks)
    for i, (r, c) in enumerate(blocks):
        if (n - 1 - i) % 2 == 0:
            for dr in range(2):
                for dc in range(2):
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = 8
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
